name: Simple Preference Change
description: Can the system recognize a preference has changed and use the latest?

conversation.content: I prefer Python for all my projects. It's the best language.
Python is great for productivity and has an incredible ecosystem.
Can you help me set up a new web project?
Sure! Since you prefer Python, shall we use FastAPI or Django?
Actually, I've changed my mind completely. I'm going all-in on Rust now. Python is too slow for what I need.
Rust is excellent for performance-critical applications. What kind of project?
A high-throughput data pipeline. What language should I use for my next project?

query: What programming language does the user currently prefer?
